Our key areas of focus for 2026
We will invest in research and insight to better understand our customers and stakeholders
We will use the Stanbic Foundation survey to assess what our partners and customers need from the
foundation and pinpoint areas for improvement
Brand health tracking, currently conducted only annually, will be performed more often in the future to
deliver additional insights
Implement the One Stanbic Strategy to strengthen customer relationships and expand the Foundation’s
activities, building on the work achieved over the past five years to foster an emotional connection with
customers
Performance‑led marketing will remain central to investment decisions, partners, and strategies as we aim
to achieve optimal returns
We will continue to build meaningful connections with our customers by sponsoring events in sport, art
and music for our corporate, business, and retail clients
